description: Fork of exp154 (BitAttention, val_bpb=1.7105 at 392M). Single change: d_qk 32 -> 64. V2D output dim doubles: P 496 -> 2016. qk_lut emits 2*d_qk = 128 reals per head (was 64); per-layer qk weights 37.75M -> 75.5M, total 392M -> ~618M. Tests whether wider Borda dim (more attention capacity) improves val_bpb. attn_scale init 0.4 kept (will likely learn upward by sqrt(2)~1.4x for matching effective scale). BitAttention TC kernel handles d=2016 fine (n_words_padded=64, beats cuDNN by 1.43x at this shape per session bench).
